div.head: Quadr II Praef 8
div.ab: Necessaria siquidem est temperantia dominis et disciplina subiectis; postquam enim ad singula queque sagax hominum penetrauit intentio et nichil ad pecuniam uisum est incommodum, creuit opulentia, creuit inuidia, ex inuidia odium, ex odio bellum: nulli fides, nulli profuit elemosina.
div.note: New row (October 2026): Liebermann’s text transcribed from Gesetze I p. 543 (two independent readings of the page images, differences settled against the page)
div.ab: For moderation is necessary to lords and discipline to subjects; for after the shrewd intent of men penetrated to each and every thing, and nothing seemed unfit for gaining money, wealth grew, envy grew, from envy hatred, from hatred war: to no one did faith, to no one did almsgiving avail.
